title.zh: 分支测试等价与双模拟

claim.zh: 两个 image-finite 模型在全部有限分支测试上同测，等价于存在关联这两个位置的双模拟。
claim.en: For two image-finite models, agreement on all finite branching tests is equivalent to a bisimulation relating the two positions.

hypotheses.zh: ExplanatoryBranching 的模型、测试与两侧 ImageFinite；既有经典逻辑依赖保留。
hypotheses.en: ExplanatoryBranching models and tests, ImageFinite on both sides, and the recorded classical logical dependencies.

correspondence.zh: 解释声称覆盖这些问题时才适用；没有证明所有测试实际可取得。
correspondence.en: Applies when the explanation covers these questions; it does not establish actual availability of all tests.

detail.zh: 脊柱上的形式：线性检验在相同之下确定时固定相同，分支检验在有限已定的框架上固定相同；本定理是核心定理（以排中律为假设，只需每一动作的结果已列出）在模型上的实例。
detail.en: The spine's form: linear tests fix likeness where frames are determined up to likeness, branching tests where they are finite and decided; this theorem is the instance on models of the core theorem with excluded middle as a hypothesis, which needs only each move's outcomes listed.

detail.zh: 该测试语言不自动表达共同占用；更丰富的共同语言有自己的关系与条件。
detail.en: This test language does not automatically express joint occupation; the richer joint language has its own relations and conditions.

limitations.zh: 该测试语言不自动表达共同占用；更丰富的共同语言有自己的关系与条件。
limitations.en: This test language does not automatically express joint occupation; the richer joint language has its own relations and conditions.

validation_scope.zh: 复用所列既有 Lean 回执；本次仅审读源码、核对声明及回执哈希对应，未重新编译。
validation_scope.en: Credits the linked existing Lean receipt. This migration reads source and checks declaration presence and receipt hash binding; it does not rerun Lean.

next_delta.zh: 动作或条件未列出时，是否有弱于排中律的原则已足够。
next_delta.en: Whether a principle weaker than excluded middle suffices where the moves or conditions are not listed.

history.en: 2026-10-08: migrated existing result identity and scope; no new theorem or relocated source.

history.zh: 2026-10-14，整合 I1（Ren：“a lot proofs are probably not integrated”）：在脊柱上陈述。以排中律为假设，核心证明：凡每一动作的结果都已列出，通过同样分支检验的配置就相同，动作与主张无须列出（alike_of_sameBranchingTests_of_em）；经 branching_bisimulation_iff 与 sameBranchingTests_iff_same，本定理即 same_iff_bisimilar_of_em，各声明公理报告为空（草稿构建；回执随落地）。动作与主张已列出时，EitherThroughout 已足够且不可少（OutcomesListed.alike_iff_sameBranchingTests、alike_of_sameBranchingTests_outcomes_iff）；框架有限且已定时无须任何原则。下一步改为问：动作或条件未列出时是否有更弱的原则。外围证明及其回执保持原范围；脊柱运行 20261014T100026.593496Z 亦将其源码作为继承模块编译并绑定。
history.en: 14 October 2026, integration I1 (Ren: “a lot proofs are probably not integrated”): stated on the spine. With excluded middle as a hypothesis, the core proves that configurations passing the same branching tests are alike wherever each move's outcomes are listed, the moves and claims unlisted (alike_of_sameBranchingTests_of_em); through branching_bisimulation_iff and sameBranchingTests_iff_same this theorem is same_iff_bisimilar_of_em, every declaration with an empty axiom report (scratch build; the receipt comes with the landing). Where the moves and claims are listed, EitherThroughout suffices and is needed (OutcomesListed.alike_iff_sameBranchingTests, alike_of_sameBranchingTests_outcomes_iff); where the frames are finite and decided, no principle is needed. The next step now asks whether a weaker principle suffices where the moves or conditions are not listed. The periphery proof and its receipt keep their scope; the spine run 20261014T100026.593496Z also compiles its source as an inherited module and binds it.
